overrides.reason: anti-toolbox: cream-family ground needs a print/paper-category justification; SEI is a wealth-technology firm, so the hit cannot be justified. Re-resolved within the rolled craft: terrazzo's cement matrix is a cool mineral grey-green, which is monochrome-tint (S 5–20%, hue outside 20°–60°).

divergence.font_deck: swiss-modernist (1950s International Style) with reflex substitutions

divergence_justifications.reason: Inter Tight is in the Inter reflex family. Archivo's width axis reaches 125, giving a 1950s extended-grotesque display (the decade of Microgramma and lobby directory boards). The decade dimension calls for it, and it is the widest available contrast with CircularXX's geometric ExtraBlack.
Inter is reflex-rejected. A reading serif for prose answers the listing-sheet register (typeset fact sheet), breaks the outgoing all-sans voice, and is on the toolkit's substitute list.
Monospace metadata is an anti-toolbox move. Labels use Archivo wdth 112 instead.

palette_source.derivation: Anchor's mineral greys + saffron kept as strategy. The anchor ground #E8EDDF is cream-flagged (R−B = 9), so it was cooled to #E6EBE7 (R−B = −1). Charcoal moved to verde-matrix #0F2B26 (terrazzo cement / verde-alpi chip). Added rose-chip (pink marble aggregate) and brass strips (terrazzo divider metal). Every text pair validated in contrastPairs.

anti_toolbox_hits.move: Oversized display numerals as section markers (near-hit: large figures)
anti_toolbox_hits.justification: Large figures appear only as the content's own captured stats/metrics inside Spec Rows (58, 15, 2,000+, $1.9T, $2B+, $206B+, 8+ years). They are never section markers or decoration, and they are stacked as a listing sheet rather than a trust bar.

anti_toolbox_hits.move: SVG noise / grain overlay on backgrounds (near-hit: terrazzo field)
anti_toolbox_hits.justification: The terrazzo field is discrete aggregate chips in palette colours, not noise or grain. It is the rolled craft and a literal picture of SEI's 'many capabilities bound under one roof' claim, it is used on two surfaces only, and it never sits behind text.

off_toolbox_moves.move: Brass divider strips replace gutters and shadows
off_toolbox_moves.basis: Terrazzo floors are poured in bays separated by brass strips; the page is laid out the same way, so separation is a material, not whitespace or elevation.

off_toolbox_moves.basis: SEI's captured hero wordplay; the line becomes the brand's divider strip. Cannot transfer to another brand's copy.

narrative.overview: Picture the floor of a 1950s financial building's lobby, poured in terrazzo. Chips of stone, glass and marble are bound in one cement matrix and divided into bays by thin brass strips. That floor is SEI's promise made physical: capabilities rarely found under one roof, joined into one surface. The system is built from slabs (flat, square-edged fields of one tone) laid side by side and separated by strips (2px brass rules). The page reads as a plan of bays, not a stack of floating cards. The register borrows the structure of a property listing sheet: facts are set in ruled specification rows, features are listed plainly and each bay has one labelled action. Type pairs a mid-century expanded grotesque (Archivo at width 125) for display and figures with a sturdy reading serif (Source Serif 4) for prose.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mineral ground (lobby stone), deep verde matrix ink, saffron chips for actions, rose chips for proof.
Square corners everywhere (0px). Depth comes from slab tone, never from shadow.
2px brass strips divide bays horizontally and vertically. They are the system's only ornament besides the terrazzo field.
Terrazzo aggregate field: discrete chips in palette colours, used on at most two surfaces per page.
Figures are set as specification rows, never as a trust bar.

rules.name: The Chip Dose Rule
rules.body: Saffron and Rose are chips, not paint. Each covers at most one full slab per page. Elsewhere they appear only as buttons, badges and aggregate.

rules.name: The No Gradient Rule
rules.body: The outgoing green→cyan field is retired. No gradients on any surface, text or border.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Archivo speaks in names, numbers and actions. Source Serif 4 speaks in sentences. A paragraph is never set in Archivo, and a button is never set in the serif.

rules.name: The No Accent Face Rule
rules.body: No third family, no italic display accents and no monospace metadata.

rules.name: The Poured Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A surface that needs emphasis changes tone or gains a brass strip. It never gains a shadow, blur or glass.

dos: Do separate bays with 2px Brass strips (#A88231) instead of gaps or shadows.
Do set every figure in Archivo wdth 125 with tabular lining numerals, inside a Spec Row.
Do keep Saffron (#F2B33D) for actions and at most one full slab per page.
Do crop images square inside a frame and keep them at their captured semantic role.
donts: Don't use rounded corners, shadows, gradients, glass or blur.
Don't reintroduce SEI's outgoing green→cyan field, red action buttons or CircularXX.
Don't line up three or four big numbers horizontally as a trust bar.
Don't put text on the terrazzo field or set display copy over a photograph.
Don't use Saffron, Rose or Brass Strip as text colours on light grounds.
